description: Reads the voltage, current or power of a measured channel, or arms a current alert.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled: a reading on every pass, an alert is armed when its setting changes.

variants.description: Reads the voltage of a channel, in millivolts.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled; gate it with a periodic block to read less often.

variants.description: Reads the current of a channel, in milliamps. A reversed shunt reads negative.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled; gate it with a periodic block to read less often.

variants.description: Reads the power of a channel, in milliwatts.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled; gate it with a periodic block to read less often.

variants.description: Arms a hardware alert that publishes an event when the current of a channel crosses a threshold.

activation.text: Arms the alert when enabled and again whenever a setting changes.
